verdict.rationale: Bruno ships a documented CLI (bru-cli) for running collections and generating reports, which serves as a programmatic/scriptable interface, and has an llms.txt for AI discoverability, but there is no true public HTTP/REST API or SDK for driving the app itself — the OpenAPI probe returned 404s across all candidate paths. missing for 10: a documented public API/SDK (REST, GraphQL, or programmatic library) beyond the CLI, independent evidence of AI agents integrating via this interface, and confirmation of API stability/versioning.
